To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the current nature reserve network in northwestern Yunnun is serving an important function for plant diversity protection; 2) the plant diversity conservation priorities are in the Hengduan Mountains and adjacent plains; 3) the current nature reserves and protected areas are not sufficient to protect all the endangered and endemic species, especially in the Hengdun Mountains and adjacent plains, where most species occur.

(1) 703 endemic species are found in northwestern Yunnun, including 98 endangered species; (2) 8 specific geographies, and one priority habitat, are identified for conservation; (3) current nature reserve system plays important role in protecting plant diversity in Northwestern Yunnun; (4) conservation of endemic plants should be integrated into the existing protected area system.

plant conservation in northwestern Yunnann can benefit from the existing nature reserve system, and that the current system should be expanded to include the remaining unprotected areas of high plant diversity.
